source.note: Auto-Rig Pro game-engine export, UE4 Mannequin preset (spine_01..03, single twist per segment). Its parent .blend holds a 344-bone ARP control rig that must never be exported directly.

repair.reason: gate_rig facing check: the authority mesh faces +Y while its skeleton correctly faces -Y, so hand_l/foot_l drive the visually right side and knees bend backwards under animation. The mesh is rotated 180 degrees about Z and every _l/_r vertex group is swapped in the same pass, which realigns geometry, weights and bone labels together. Verified by re-running gate_rig on the exported result.

normalize.target_height_reason: Measured 0.952 m. The reference is an adult male ninja, so this is a scale defect, not art direction -- it would import into UE5 as a child-sized character. Rescaled uniformly to 1.80 m. Change target_height_m here if the intent really was a small character.

budget_waiver.reason: Dense generated-and-repaired topology inherited from the legacy studio. Retopology to the 20k budget is scheduled work, not a blocker for engine validation. Deformation is correct at 4 influences with zero unweighted vertices.

texture_waiver.reason: Textures are inherited from the legacy back-projection stage, which used a per-patch xatlas layout and baked its lighting into the albedo. Regenerating them is scheduled work; the measured numbers are recorded here so the debt stays visible rather than silently passing.
